stock.description: Fantasia Holdings Group Co., Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in real estate development across the People's Republic of China. Its diversified operations are organized into six key segments: Property Development, Property Investment, Property Agency Services, Property Operation Services, Hotel Operation, and other miscellaneous activities. The company constructs a variety of properties, ranging from business complexes to luxury residential developments, and also manages the leasing of its investment properties. It further provides community support services through an online platform, alongside offering comprehensive property and commercial management solutions. Fantasia also has a significant presence in the financial sector, delivering services like wealth management, financial leasing, small loans, peer-to-peer lending, fund management, factoring, consumer finance, insurance, and payment systems. Beyond property and finance, the group extends its offerings to include value-added services, travel agency operations, property project management, and engineering services. Its hospitality and leisure portfolio encompasses the management of hotels, golf courses, city and private clubs, theme parks, and art museums. Notably, Fantasia specializes in senior care, developing and operating home-based care facilities, daytime centers, and specialized apartments that provide a wide array of services, including healthcare, rehabilitation, nutritional support, spiritual well-being, and educational programs for the elderly. In a distinct undertaking, the company additionally manufactures and distributes fuel pumps. Established in 1996, Fantasia Holdings Group Co., Limited is headquartered in Shenzhen, China, and operates as a subsidiary of Fantasy Pearl International Limited.
